name: Vultr Server
description: Host Recursive on a Vultr cloud server that joins your Tailscale network. Nothing on it is open to the internet.

provider.label: Vultr
provider.description: An always-on cloud server in 30+ cities from about $10 a month, private to your tailnet.

schema.label: Vultr API key
schema.description: Account → API. Allow this computer's IP in the key's access control, or allow all.

schema.label: Tailscale auth key
schema.description: A reusable or one-off key from the Tailscale admin console (Settings → Keys). The server joins your tailnet with it; this computer must be on the same tailnet.
